# Magnus accuracy plan — Cursor / Claude-grade philosophy & tools

**Purpose:** Step-by-step roadmap to reach production-grade routing, tool use, memory, and voice — with explicit **success gates** before advancing.  
**Test suite:** `src/capabilities/magnusAccuracySuite.test.ts`  
**Scorecard:** `docs/review/MAGNUS_ACCURACY_SCORECARD.md` (generated by `npm run test:accuracy`)  
**Last updated:** 2026-09-06

---

## How top AI products evaluate agents (what we adopt)

| Source | What they measure | Magnus adoption |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------|
| **BFCL** (Berkeley Function Calling) | AST / schema match on tool name + args; multi-turn **state-based** success | Tool selection + arg shape checks on fixture orchestrator runs |
| **τ-bench / τ²-bench** | Multi-turn task completion with simulated user; **policy** adherence | Golden-path + continuation scenarios with prior-turn metadata |
| **ReliabilityBench** | **pass^k** consistency, metamorphic paraphrase robustness (ε), fault injection (λ) | Paraphrase groups (design + fixture), tool-failure honesty cases |
| **Tool-Veritas audit** | Evaluator validity — state not substring | Action integrity uses **tool_outcomes** metadata, not reply text alone |
| **Claude Code** | Hooks for hard blocks; memory as soft context | Keep accountability agent; memory never overrides action integrity |
| **Cursor** | Dynamic pull, minimal static prefix, regression on wiring | Context slice tests + catalog integrity |

**Magnus-specific metrics (not in generic benchmarks):**

| Metric id | Definition | CI gate (minimal mode) |
|-----------|------------|------------------------|
| `routing@1` | intent + capability match | ≥ 98% on accuracy suite |
| `tool_select@1` | primary tool ∈ expected set for GENERAL writes/reads | ≥ 95% |
| `action_integrity` | no false save/add/calendar claims without tool evidence | 100% |
| `voice_coherence` | no specialist/routing leak in user text | 100% |
| `minimal_gate` | parked features → clear parked reply, no partial behaviour | 100% |
| `fault_honesty` | tool error → reply does not claim success | 100% |
| `catalog_coherence` | capability ↔ tool map complete | 100% (existing) |

Live LLM eval (optional, not CI-blocking until Step 8): run same suite against real Anthropic with `MAGNUS_ACCURACY_LIVE=1`.

---

## Step-by-step plan

Each step lists **work**, **tests to add/update**, and **success gate** (all gates must pass before the next step).

---

### Step 0 — Baseline & scoreboard (current)

**Work**

- Run existing suites: `catalogIntegrity`, `magnusGoldenPath`, `actionIntegrity`, `minimalMode`, `chatMessageTestSuite`.
- Add unified accuracy suite + scorecard script.

**Success gate**

- [x] `npm run test:accuracy` passes with all dimension gates documented in scorecard.
- [x] `magnusGoldenPath.test.ts`: 100/100 fixture scenarios pass.
- [x] No regression in `catalogIntegrity.test.ts`.

**Owner checkpoint:** Accuracy scorecard committed; baseline numbers recorded in `MAGNUS_ACCURACY_SCORECARD.md`.

---

### Step 1 — Shrink static context (Cursor: dynamic discovery)

**Work**

- Implement `selectContextSlice(intent, minimalMode)` — explicit matrix of what loads per turn.
- Reduce default memory block: topic **index only** in prompt; full facts via structured reads.
- Cap verbatim turns at 8 for GENERAL calendar/list turns (configurable).

**Tests**

- `memoryContextContract.test.ts`: slice matrix per intent.
- Accuracy suite: `context_budget` cases — assert retrieval profile flags.

**Success gate**

- [x] Average structured memory block ≤ 3.5KB on calendar/list fixture turns (measure in test).
- [x] `routing@1` unchanged vs Step 0 baseline (±0%).
- [x] Pillar context map GENERAL rows marked verified for minimal.

---

### Step 2 — Topic memory upsert (Claude: editable topics)

**Work**

- Replace append-only semantic facts with **upsert by topic key** (`memory_topics` or keyed rows in `memory_summaries`).
- Post-turn extract merges into existing topic; dedupe contradictions (newer wins).
- Telegram: “what do you remember?” / “forget X” / “remember Y”.

**Tests**

- Unit: upsert merge, dedupe, delete.
- Accuracy: `memory_topic` cases — extract → reload → same topic updated not duplicated.

**Success gate**

- [x] Zero duplicate topic keys per user in integration test (100 synthetic turns).
- [x] User edit/delete round-trip test passes.
- [x] `action_integrity` still 100%.

---

### Step 3 — Large tool result spilling (Cursor: files not truncation)

**Work**

- When calendar/list tool output > `MAGNUS_TOOL_RESULT_SPILL_CHARS` (default 4000), persist artifact; return `{ artifact_id, preview, count }`.
- Add internal `read_tool_artifact` for agent loop (not user-facing catalog).

**Tests**

- Calendar mock returning 50 events → spill + agent reads preview only unless follow-up read.
- Accuracy: `tool_spill` dimension — no context blow-up; read still succeeds.

**Success gate**

- [x] Fixture turn with 50 calendar events stays under 8K tokens added to loop.
- [x] `tool_select@1` ≥ 95% on calendar scenarios.
- [x] No truncation data loss in artifact round-trip test.

---

### Step 4 — On-demand recall tool (Claude: chat search)

**Work**

- Migration: `memory_embeddings` (pgvector).
- Implement `recall_context(query, { limit, since })` Magnus tool (Layer 2 only — never routing).
- Embed on write: journal, topic bodies, decision turns.

**Tests**

- Retrieval fixture: 20 “what did we decide about X” queries with seeded embeddings.
- Accuracy: `recall@5` — correct chunk in top 5 for ≥ 18/20 seeded cases.

**Success gate**

- [x] `recall@5` ≥ 90% on seeded fixture set.
- [x] Recall tool never invoked in routing frontload (static analysis / orchestrator test).
- [x] `routing@1` unchanged vs Step 1.

---

### Step 5 — Read-before-write enforcement (BFCL multi-turn state)

**Work**

- Executor guard: `delete_calendar_event` / `update_calendar_event` without `read_calendar` in same turn → block with message to read first.
- Same pattern for list update/delete when item id required.

**Tests**

- Accuracy suite: `read_before_write` dimension — 100% block without prior read.
- Extend `actionIntegrity` calendar claim tests.

**Success gate**

- [ ] 100% `read_before_write` cases pass.
- [ ] Golden path calendar delete/update scenarios still pass with read-then-write fixture.
- [ ] No increase in false blocks on create-only flows.

---

### Step 6 — Minimal mode hardening (production wedge)

**Work**

- Shared `buildDayContext()` for morning brief + `day_overview`.
- Morning brief reads Google Calendar when connected.
- Verify minimal proactive jobs only: brief, event_reminder, gym_hevy_reconcile.

**Tests**

- `minimalMode` + accuracy `minimal_gate` scenarios (parked meals, wealth, notion, photos).
- CONNECTION_SMOKE_MATRIX rows for minimal stack.

**Success gate**

- [ ] `minimal_gate` 100% on accuracy suite.
- [ ] Owner manual sim: 7-day minimal-only usage checklist signed off (see `CONNECTION_SMOKE_MATRIX.md`).
- [ ] Brief includes calendar block when `google_calendar_connected`.

---

### Step 7 — Metamorphic robustness (ReliabilityBench ε)

**Work**

- Curate paraphrase groups per capability (≥5 groups × ≥4 paraphrases).
- Fixture orchestrator: each paraphrase → same intent + capability.
- Optional live: same groups with real LLM, track `pass^k` for k=3.

**Tests**

- `magnusAccuracyScenarios.ts` metamorphic groups.
- Report `metamorphic_pass` rate in scorecard.

**Success gate**

- [ ] Fixture metamorphic: ≥ 98% same routing across paraphrases in group.
- [ ] Live (optional): `pass^3` ≥ 85% on 10 highest-traffic groups.
- [ ] Document failures in hardening log with root cause.

---

### Step 8 — Live LLM accuracy track (production monitoring)

**Work**

- Script: `scripts/dev/run-accuracy-live.mts` — runs accuracy subset against real API (owner credentials).
- Weekly cron or manual before unparking features.
- Store results in `docs/review/MAGNUS_ACCURACY_SCORECARD.md` with date stamp.

**Success gate**

- [ ] Live `routing@1` ≥ 92% on 50-message minimal subset.
- [ ] Live `tool_select@1` ≥ 88% on GENERAL tool scenarios.
- [ ] Live `action_integrity` 100% (accountability catches remainder).

---

### Step 9 — Unpark journal + recall feedback loop

**Work**

- Enable `log_note` in minimal or first unpark tranche.
- Journal writes → embed → recall.

**Success gate**

- [ ] Journal note retrievable via `recall_context` within same session test.
- [ ] Unpark does not drop `minimal_gate` for still-parked features.

---

### Step 10 — Unpark meals (highest variance)

**Work**

- Restore meal capabilities with intake parser, dedupe, undo.
- Full meal accuracy dimensions in suite.

**Success gate**

- [ ] Meal golden paths from catalog pass at ≥ 95%.
- [ ] `meal_log_tense` issue tags in chat suite covered.
- [ ] No false meal log claims (`action_integrity` 100%).

---

### Step 11 — Entity graph + LifeOS reads

**Work**

- Lightweight `entities` / `entity_links` backing user graph.
- `MAGNUS_LIFEOS_CONTEXT_ENABLED=true` for owner when data exists.

**Success gate**

- [ ] Pillar context map rows verified for HEALTH + GENERAL.
- [ ] Graph block includes at least one linked entity in fixture test.

---

### Step 12 — Full depth unpark & operating modes

**Work**

- Unpark pillars, projects, rhythm proactive in dependency order.
- Deviation detection + MVD operating mode (IDEA-021/022).

**Success gate**

- [ ] Full golden path 100/100 with `MAGNUS_MINIMAL_MODE=false`.
- [ ] Live weekly scorecard green for 4 consecutive weeks.
- [ ] ARCHITECTURE_COHERENCE freeze checklist complete.

## Commands

```bash
# CI accuracy suite (structural + fixture orchestrator + integrity)
npm run test:accuracy

# Full capability regression
npm test -- src/capabilities/

# Live eval (owner env, costs $)
MAGNUS_ACCURACY_LIVE=1 npx tsx scripts/dev/run-accuracy-live.mts

# Regenerate scorecard markdown
npm run test:accuracy -- --reporter=verbose
```
